- Latency SLO: 95th < 250ms for end-to-end search + rerank (embedding lookup + top-k rerank using 1-2 re-ranker calls)

- Prefer hosted open-model embeddings (cost tradeoffs), but open to Redwood-verified smaller models for reranker to reduce latency.
